[EN] What Comes after Charred?

[EN] Deal with those fangspawns before they incinerate the forest!

[EN] Only you could have prevented the forest fires.

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Hunt the searing fangspawn east of the Emergency Camp.
[ES] Caza a las crías de colmillo abrasadoras al este del Campamento de Emergencia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you very much."
[ES] "Muchas gracias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Nurun.
